metadata_note: Refined seating geometry is validated separately from the preserved earlier package. Only the explicitly selected runs/refined-final evidence may accompany this revision, and its source and asset fingerprints must match the packaged bytes. Media is omitted until a real upload exists; this development package is not a board submission.

diagnostic_sources.task_docking_fixture.py: Preclamped reset for isolated grasp and docking contact diagnostics. It does not satisfy the full task's seen-open history and must never be presented as a complete task demonstration. Its debug runs are excluded.

seating_evidence_policy.interpretation: The original whole-stand straight-extraction check may remain false: the existing angled lever obstructs that nominal path. Do not rewrite its report. Assembly evidence requires all physical seating checks, a source-matched exact check of the corrected insertion path, and the new successful full robot recording; straight-up removal is not claimed.

allowed_runtime_modules.name: OmniGlass.mdl
allowed_runtime_modules.verification: Read the installed module and its exported OmniGlass material. Installed kit/kernel/config/kit-core.json declares ${kit}/mdl/core/Base/ in renderer.mdl.searchPaths.templates. Installed Isaac Lab visual_materials_cfg.py uses OmniGlass.mdl for its glass material.
allowed_runtime_modules.requirement: The renderer must supply this built-in module and its own transitive MDL imports; it is not a missing local task asset.

optional_verified_demo.selection: Only runs/refined-final from the separately staged refined task; no fallback to an earlier successful run
optional_verified_demo.eligibility: variant full, success true, task_score 1.0, at most 2400 steps, at least one video, unchanged before/after source fingerprints matching the package, and a passing final-four-second 240 Hz settling report matching the physics trace hash

excluded_by_design: failed or unselected debug runs and their logs or snapshots
earlier geometry success results or benchmarks without current source/asset fingerprints
docking-fixture runs presented as full-task proof
staging probes, tuning sweeps, bytecode caches and temporary archives
comb, loose gasket, parts tray and other assets not used by this task
static assembly sequence files and product-view renders presented as manipulation results
credentials, machine-specific configuration and unrelated repository files
license_note: Copy the existing original asset/code notices unchanged. README documents the adapted scenekit.py provenance and the absence of an identified explicit upstream license; the asset code MIT notice does not relicense borrowed integration code.
